title: An unconfirmed outside-content restatement does not reorder
what: A guard of the restated-note rule (A33). Alice records a fact, then later writes the update while declaring it came from outside content (a web page) that nobody has confirmed. Outside text must not be able to push a note back, even through the same writer: the order stays as the search ranks it and nothing is labelled as restated.

steps.title: {{proj}} build server moved
steps.body: Update: {{proj}} builds moved off the old box; the build server is now {{v2}}.

expect.desc: search keeps the note first: unconfirmed outside content never moves it
the 'what is relevant' lookup keeps it first
no note is labelled as restated
